Dirty Air #4

Redeemed

Lauren Asher

4.30
99,246 ratings10,365 reviews
Rate this book
Santiago Alatorre
One mistake destroys my career.
I go from most eligible bachelor to monster, hiding from the world.
At least until Chloe breaks into my home.
My new fake girlfriend is a temporary fix to my biggest problem.
But as our game changes, so do my feelings.
There’s only one issue stopping me from claiming her.
Me.

Chloe Carter
It all started with a birthday wish, some vodka, and an ancestry kit.
That’s how I end up in Italy, finding my long-lost father.
But one decision lands me a fake boyfriend I don’t want.
The more we pretend, the easier our ruse becomes.
I told myself not to fall in love with a liar like Santiago.
I should have listened.

Redeemed is a steamy standalone in the Dirty Air world.

About Me:

Lauren Asher is a New York Times, USA Today, Sunday Times, Globe and Mail, and Publishers Weekly bestselling author of contemporary romance. She enjoys writing about flawed yet relatable characters you can’t help falling in love with and fictional worlds you wish were real.

Her favorite activities outside of writing include DIY projects, binging old episodes of Parks and Rec, and searching Yelp for new restaurants before choosing her trusted favorite. She works best after her morning coffee and will never deny a nap.

5 stars!

“I don’t want to see the world through rose-colored glasses. I want to see it with a wildflower heart like yours, desperately chasing after what makes me happy, wild, and free. And most of all, I want to chase after it with you.”

Lauren Asher has come such a long way with this series and her writing with each book improved so much like I love it so much, the development?? because I know for sure I can spot the difference between her writing style in this book and throttled. The way she deals with mental health in her books will forever be my favorite part about her books because we saw it with Jax and here we see it with Chloe and Santi and it is just so well done right to the last minute details. I also loved the pacing of this book, it was perfect. It wasnt too slow or too fast, it was just perfect because by the end of this book I felt fulfilled. This book was magic and I can easily call this my favorite sports romance 💖

Santiago Alatorre, you guys literally cannot understand the love that I have for him, I waited for his book for the longest time, wanting for it to destroy me and it did but it also brought me so much joy because Santi was the best male lead to read about, his trauma and his disability is portrayed so well and the way Lauren showed how even perfect people are flawed. He was so caring and thoughtful. His character felt very real because we saw Santi go through the worst conditions and we saw him at his darkest parts but his healing journey was so heartfelt and beautiful. I honestly can not stress it enough. His relationship with Marko was so damn cute. Every scene of those two together was so cute (it honestly felt like a single dad romance at times) because Santi treated Marko as his own child and every interaction had me swooning.

Noah and Santi, there relationship deserves a separate paragraph because I have not come across a single book where the bond between two friends is so pure to the extent that they are such a main integral part of their journey and Noah being there for Santi had my heart exploding 💗 the steps that Noah took for Santi, to have him back, to give him his life back had me on the edge of tears because if you look back at their relationship in throttled where they nearly hated each other, it feels so surreal to see them bonding to this length.

Chloe, man I loved her so much, she was the perfect representation of sunshine and she brought so much light into this book and Santi's journey. I liked how the story focused on her health as well and how she was suffering from domestic abuse as well and the way she coped through it and found her courage to deal with it was so damn admirable and I loved how determined she was. She set a goal to find her father and she literally traveled all the way to Italy to do so and man I felt so bad for her at times but I loved how the story wrapped up for her. Her relationship with Brooke is also so underrated because like Santi had Noah, Chloe had Brooke with her throughout her dark times and I love when friendships like theirs are represented throughout books.

The romance, was easily my favorite part for this book. Santi and Chloe were a match made in heaven. The way they both were so troubled with their lives but felt so comfortable with each other, so at peace and felt so real. How Chloe brought out the best parts of Santi that he thought he lost long ago and the way Santi did that for Chloe was perfect. I love how well their relationship was developed and how unlike most romance elements in this series this one did not have insta-lust because it made the relationship more fleshed out and more drawn out. The moment their Hate to love fake dating started, I knew that I was going to be head over heels in love with them and I was so right about that, the tension and the chemistry between them felt so real and the way both of them just connected with each other had me in tears, I also was not expecting there relationship to be so deep and I absolutely loved how deep it actually was because it just made it 100x better.

The way their interactions were so well done and the whole overall vibe of their encounters and the build up to their romance was done perfectly and the best part was the romance actually played such a main role in their healing journey that, that alone made it worth my time and I honestly did not even feel the need for smut (there were like two scenes) but I would have enjoyed the book the same amount if there were none because the relationship was so pure that it could stand-out without the need for smut. One more thing that I appreciated a lot was how Santi was so caring about Chloe and lengths that he went for her to feel home and for her to be safe and loved and I also loved how Chloe brought down this wall that Santi had built around her throughout the years he suffered and ahh I cannot stress- I dont even have the words to tell you how perfect it was.

I actually want a spin-off series (dirty heirs) pls let it be Laurens next project. Overall, it was the best conclusion, that somehow managed to exceed my already high expectations and I would recommend it to everyone. It is Lauren Ashers finest work.

Quotes that I loved:

“Because in the end, nothing is more fearful than realizing life goes on, with or without you”

“I think we owe it to ourselves to unapologetically love who we are no matter what. Because if you don’t love yourself, then why do you expect anyone else to?”

“Because those who see beauty in chaos also see flowers instead of weeds, and that’s a gift in a world like ours.”

"Loving you feels like I found a life raft in the middle of a raging ocean."

“She’s like the moon who shines bright despite the never-ending darkness. And she makes me want to wish that daylight never comes again.”

Song that I loved listening to while reading this: National Anthem by Lana Del Rey

Rating for the series:
Throttled: 4.25
Collided: 3.75
Wrecked: 4.45
Redeemed: 5.00

"You want to know what love feels like?"
"Yes."
"Loving you feels like I found a life raft in the middle of a raging ocean."

This book was perfect. Everything went right in this. The characters, the romance, the plot, the writing, mental health rep- basically everything. I swear this one is the best in the series. It made up for the bs Wrecked was..

"Loving you is like the first day of spring after a harsh winter.
Loving you is like the ocean. Infinite. Fierce. Breathtaking."

Santiago and Chloe made me yearn for something that they have. The two actually connected, and had genuine chemistry. The romance and the bond between them was so beautifully crafted and went in so deep, that I didn't even care for any spice. I could just read about them talking to each other for another 500+ pages with no regrets. They corrected their mistakes, called the other out, laughed together and genuinely wanted to know each other. One of the best parts about this book? It's not insta love. Sure, there's attraction but they take their time.

Santiago and Chloe also have traumas that ran deep, both different and yet that's not all they are. Lauren Asher brilliantly writes the mental health representation, shows the reality of coping with disability, domestic violence, abuse, drug addiction and miscarriage.

Another thing that I appreciated was Noah and Santiago's friendship. Noah, you brilliant man. Thanks for that support you showed my man Santiago.

It sucks that this series is over. It sucks that I now have to come back to reality. But am so happy I read this series. I would say Redeemed and Throttled are the best ones.

Series Rating-
1. Throttled- ⭐⭐⭐⭐
2. Collided- ⭐⭐⭐⭐
3. Wrecked- ⭐⭐
4. Redeemed- ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

♾️ Infinite stars for Santiago and Chloe because this book was beyond P E R F E C T I O N . I lived and loved their story and ate every word and every chloesantiago moment. I thought I was just obsessed with Santi when he first appeared in Throttled but now he owns my heart. For me this book was everything and I won't change a single thing about it. Santiago and Chloe have all my heart.


“She’s like the moon who shines bright despite the never-ending darkness. And she makes me want to wish that daylight never comes again.”



I dived in this book with so many expectations and every one of them was proved right. I knew I would be giving this book a 5 stars just after reading the first few chapters and prologue. Lauren why do you always write such emotional prologues. I was heartbroken after reading what happened to Santiago and how it broke everything inside him. The starting was chaotic and iconic. Chloe climbed a tree in his future husband's house and and kicked him in the balls and called him a theif and then they ended up fake dating each other.

The story was perfect. Heartwarming, beautiful and comforting but also heartbreaking because of what both the characters went through in their life. I cried so many times but there were moments that had me giggling, swooning and squealing because how cute and wholesome they were together. I loved everything—their witty banter, fake dating, their chemistry, the sexual tension which was palpable and hot, the way they confessed their love for each other, their little family moments with Marko, the found family trope when Santi's family accepted Chloe as their own and Santiago calling Chloe "my little criminal", "little wildflower" 💗💞💘🦋✨️ Just add a little with any nickname to throw my feminism out the window.


“You suck,” Chloe mumbles under her breath. 
I tuck a strand of her hair behind her ear and lean in to whisper, “My goal is for you to suck, but this is good enough for now.”



I loved the way healing and trauma was represented and how they both helped each other in that process. It was not just mentioned for the sake of making this a sad story but there was actual focus on Santiago's journey and how he gained his confidence and how Chloe and Noah helped him healed mentally and physically. I loved that he did it and made those decisions for himself and for his future.


“It’s just a game.” 
“It’s more than that.”
“How so?”
“This is your redemption.”


This was a small town romance set up in Italy but with no nosy neighbours and I loved it. The vibes in this book were everything. I loved that we also get to see Noah and Maya in this and how their life was going so far. I didn't like Noah in his book but possessive husband and protective daddy Noah is something else 🤭💘 and Marko was so cute 🥹 My ovaries were bursting everytime Santi spent his time with Marko and how Marko calls him his Iron Man 🥹 I knew Santi will have the most kids in this series because his personality literally screams "I'm the daddiest daddy material give me all the kids."


“Some kisses stoke a passion. Some kisses heal the soul. Kissing Chloe is a combination of two—the sweetest medicine that leads to a lifelong addiction.”



Lauren's writing has improved a lot. This is my favourite book of her so far and it was written so beautifully. It's the way she focused on characters' growth throught the story and how there was more of an emotional and intimate connection between Santi and Chloe than just lust and physical attraction. It was amazing to see how she focused on Santiago's disablity and his journey to racing in F1 again.


➸ Santiago Alatorre

He is hot, a F1 racer, has a hot name, he cooks, plays guitar, he babysits, he blushes for his girl and he's grumpy and he can also be so sweet sometimes. My kind of kryptonite. I was heartbroken everytime he denied that he couldn't become the racer he was. He secluded himself from the world and he was lonely everyday for 3 years. It was painful to see him go through all that. But I loved how he tried to be better for himself and for the future he wanted with Chloe. Man was so rich that he had SIXTEEN BEDROOMS IN HIS GOTHIC MANSION!?!? I loved that Santi isn't like other MMCs written by Lauren. He did liked Chloe and was attracted towards her but atleast he wasn't lusting after her like the other MMCs in this series. Santiago raised my standards to another level because he recreated Chloe's favourite scene from her favourite movie 😭😭, embroidered her a gift, wrote a letter and even gave her a bouquet of wildflowers!?!??! And you are telling me that SANTIAGO ALATORRE IS FICTIONAL!??! He is the definition of perfect book husband.


“And most of all, loving you is realizing heaven isn’t a place, but a person.”


➸ Chloe Carter

The sunshine of this book. Her first day in Italy to find and establish a relationship with her father who never knew she ever existed and she already broke into someone's (Santi's) house, tried to climb his tree and fell, knee him in the balls, and also had a crush on him even though she thought he was dangerous, fled from there but left her phone in Santi's house but called him the thief, and then again tried to break into his house and became his fake girlfriend. She is chaotic, sweet but also very kindhearted. I love how she bosses around Santi sometimes and didn't let him have his way with her. I loved the way she helped Santi to get him out of his bubble and the way she loved him so selflessly. One thing that I learned from her is that wishes so do come true whether you write in youe wish journal or not.


“And most of all, loving you is realizing I don’t have to make a wish ever again because I already have everything I could ever want.”


╰┈➤ Their relationship

They went from fake-hate dating to helping each other to loving each other. Their relationship progressed throughout the entire book and I loved every second of it. The slow burn in this was burning and the chemitry between them was amazing. Chloe never had any love or loving family in her life but Santi was there for her to show her that very thing with his actions. He even set up a online shop for her and bought every machine and material she needed to start her embroidery business. I love them with all my heart.


“You might not realize it, but you’re a wildflower. You grow in the most unexpected places, no matter who tramples on you or ignores your beauty. You can grow in a field, or through a crack in the sidewalk, but the result will always be the same. No one can stop you from flourishing in a world set on ignoring you. You have a way of turning any situation, good or bad, into something magnificent.”



I loved that how Chloe made Santi feel comfortable in his own skin before they had any physically intimacy. He wasn't comfortable in showing his prosthetic leg to anyone so she just gave him time he needed but also showed him that he is everything she ever wanted. The intimacy they shared was beyond just some lust or attraction. They fit so well in each other's life like they were made from the same yet the different mould and were just waiting to find their way back to each other. I guess you could say they are ✨️ SOULMATES ✨️


“I promise it doesn’t matter to me if you’re missing a leg, or an arm, or anything else. It doesn’t define the person you are.” She places her palm against my heart. “This does. And you happen to have one of the prettiest ones.”


“Chloe didn’t just steal a piece of my heart. She carved her initials into it, branding me for life.”



I loved the way Chloe slowly and steadily broke the walls Santi had build around himself and helped him move on and healed him in the darkest moments of his life and how Santi helped her when she was trying to get to know her father and and earned her trust and love and told her how she deserves so much more in her life. It was beautiful.


“It took one chance encounter with a stranger to change my life. One person to make me realize that I can’t love someone else until I love myself. One dreamer who makes me want to wish in journals or on lucky stars or on damn dandelions for all I care. One girl. One love. One forever.”



The ending was perfect with the sweetest and the most wholesome and heartwarming epilogue ever. There was a bit conflict in the end but it wasn't dragged out and I didn't mind it because the way Santi asked for Chloe's forgiveness was everything and it skyrocketed my expectations to another level. I never was a fan of HEA until Lauren's books. This book had one of the beautiful and the cutest epilogue. Can Lauren just write some more bonus chapters for them because I want MORE and this wasn't enough. I also want Marko and Stella's book. Marko is just like Noah but better and Stella seems like she'll be making him run for his life. Santiago and Chloe's story was the perfect one to end this series.

I am not ready to say goodbye to this series. I am sitting here a week later and still think about how this book affected me. At three percent, I was sobbing and at ten percent, I was laughing so hard; I was crying. F1 is my favorite, and Lauren Asher kills it. Each time she perceives the book before.

I was not a fan of Santi until this book. What happened to him, in the beginning, my heart poured out for him. But man, I didn't see half of what was to come and how he grew. I fell in love with him. You couldn't ask for a better book boyfriend. A tortured soul that went through such trauma. How he turned it around and held his head up high. So proud of him.

Chloe hooked me in for the beginning. How she survived her childhood and moved forward, so inspiring. Now add heart of gold, sass, small criminal activity, with a smart mouth, you now have the perfect heroine. She made me laugh out loud on several occasions.

There’s three pedals. Why are there three pedals?” She moans

“Because automatic cars are for grandmas.”  “Okay, that’s fine. I’ll own up to being a grandma because I barely go out anyway. I mean, I embroider as a hobby. I’m practically one year away from fostering cats and living the rest of my life attached to an oxygen tank.”


Santi teaching Chole to drive is the funniest, ever. To me. Their relationship is perfect with high and low and growth together. Such a beautiful love story. We see all our favorites. Noah played a big part in the book and still proves how he takes care of the ones he loves.

Every time I read a book in this series, I realize how much I miss the racing world. I get lost in her writing and can picture the race in front of me. Asher is a very talented writer. I hope to see a spin-off series and read about the next generation. If you haven't read this series, I recommend you do. You will not be disappointed.

Wow! Lauren, you managed to surprise me with this one! I loved this so much, and it has become my favorite of the series. The way that the writing has improved and how she interpreted depression and a disability was just absolutely beautiful.


Redeemed is the final book in the Dirty Air series. It is a fake dating, one bed, gumpy/sunshine, F1 sports romance with trauma, healing, forced proximity, and witty and sexy banter that was everything. There were definitely moments that had my heart breaking and pulling at my heartstrings, but also times when I couldn't stop my out loud laughter.


Santiago Alatorre experienced a life changing event during one of his races when he crashed, causing him to lose his driving leg. Now, three years later, he has secluded himself to his home and closed himself off from the world, including his family. That is until Chloe Carter is caught climbing his tree to get a view into her father's yard. He startles her, causing her to fall and lose her phone, and she leaves in a hurry, leaving her phone behind. The next night, she returns and breaks into his house to retrieve her phone only to be met by Santiago's sister and brother-in-law. He had been trying to prove to them that he is capable of watching his nephew while they're away for the F1 break. He tells them that Chloe is his girlfriend and is going to help him out with babysitting. Santiago shows up at the coffee shop Chloe is working at one day to tell her the truth about who he is and to apologize to her. But her boss intervenes, and she panics, telling him that he is her boyfriend in hopes that she can get closer to him and reveal her secret of him being her father. Will she get to have a relationship with her father that she wishes for? And will her and Santiago stop pretending and tell each other how they really feel?


“You shouldn’t have doubted me.” “I never did.” “Then why make a bet in the first place?” “Because how can you focus on being anxious if you’re too focused on winning something you want?” My gaze darkens as I focus on her lips. “I won more than a race today.” She winks. “And don’t you forget it.”


I loved the relationship between Noah and Santiago. They have formed a brotherly bond that is strong, still pushing each other when given the chance. We also met Marko, Maya, and Noah's son, who is just the cutest. We didn't see much of the other couples from the other books, but they all showed up when Santiago needed them. I love their connection and found family so much!


Chloe Carter destroyed me in every way I needed. She broke me apart before gluing me back together, repairing me from the inside out. I’m not letting this girl get away. Not now and not ever.

“I love you, Chloe. And it’s okay if you don’t know what it means to be loved by someone, let alone love someone else because I promise to love you enough for the two of us. To love you every day to make up for everyone else who failed miserably.”


Santiago and Chloe have both been hurt in their lives, though, in different ways. Chloe grew up in a toxic home with her mother until she was placed in foster care with her mother still trying to take advantage of her now and Santiago was off to a good start of his career when it was taken from him and he allowed it to take over his life that is until Chloe. She doesn't see him the way he sees himself as a broken man and pushes him to love himself again and he helps her with overcoming her fear of letting someone show her what it feels like to be cared for and loved. Together, they help each other heal.


Where most people see weeds, I only see you— my beautiful wildflower, untamed and free.

“Life is about creating the memories that matter while forgetting the ones that don’t.”


I adored the gestures that they did for one another. Chloe supported Santiago and pushed him to fight for one of the things that he wanted most, and that was behind the wheel of an F1 car and racing again. I adored that he made a craft room for her embroidery because she loves to make things, and she had a custom helmet made for him with Iron Man's arc reactor symbol on it because that's what Marko calls him.

“And most of all, loving you is realizing I don’t have to make a wish ever again because I already have everything I could ever want.”


I loved the ending and epilogue it was beautiful and heartwarming, making me cry happy tears for them.There was a misunderstanding when Santi was trying to protect Chloe, but he redeemed himself in the best ways. I'm sad to be saying goodbye to this series, but it couldn't have ended any better than with Santiago and Chloe getting everything that they hoped and wished for because they deserve nothing less.

ೀ🏎️𖦹⋆𓈒 ”Magic is everywhere and in everything. People only have to believe in it for it to work. If you notice it, then embrace it because that’s what makesus dreamers.” 𓍢ִ໋🌷͙֒✧˚ ༘⋆

-ˏˋ4.5 ☆ˊˎ-

I think I somehow forgot how much this book made me feel, because writing this review and going through every quote I annotated is making me tear up and wanting to reread this. Ugh, I love their love 😩

I love when a romance goes beyond a couple falling in love and explores important themes that need to be more talked about and are approached and written well. Lauren’s books have that. I love the way she creates characters that feel real with their life experiences and struggles while also having an entertaining plot.

This is the 4th installment in the series, that follows Chloe and Santiago, but I found it very different from the rest. It’s not so focused on F1 but more on the story of two individuals and the struggles of two broken people coming together. I had no idea about the themes written in this book, the only thing I knew was that it was emotional. I’m not gonna give a summary or talk about what really goes on because it’s a huge spoiler and given it’s the 4th book, I think the best way to go into this is blind. Just know it’s different from the other three and can be more emotional given some events. As always Lauren touches really important and different subjects, and portraits mental health in the best way!

“Because those who see beauty in chaos also see flowers instead of weeds, and that’s a gift in a world like ours.”

Even though I really did enjoy this I’ve gotta say I was expecting more in some ways. I think that’s my fault because I love emotional books and from what I had heard I thought this would be heartbreaking. I was ready to sob (and I am the biggest crier!), and I only teared once because their love was so pure! Also there’s a lot of people saying this is Lauren’s best work to date and having read her other series I was ready to get my heart shattered in a million pieces and that didn’t happen, I was just expecting more! That’s not to say it’s not an amazing book with an emotional plot line, because it is! Lauren has come so far since writing Throttled and it shows!

She’s like the moon who shines bright despite the never-ending darkness. And she makes me want to wish that daylight never comes again.

This book had the best kind of romance!! It’s not a slow burn but it’s also not insta love. Is there attraction? Sure, but it’s not rushed. You see two people meeting in the oddest way and ending up in a fake relationship, and then getting to know each other and uplifting one another in the best kind of way. And sometimes the fake relationship trope can be cringy and unreasonable, but this wasn’t at all! Both Chloe and Santi have their own and very different issues and it’s so lovely to see them coming together and accepting each other. They are literally perfect! The amount of butterflies I have just by thinking about them!

While positivity keeps me going, perseverance is what gives me the courage to fight for another day. To move forward and start a new life for myself pursuing whatever makes me happy.

𓍢ִ໋🌷͙֒ Chloe was so sweet and fierce and the definition of sunshinian hurricane!! She went through so much growing up and still doesn’t have what we call “a great life”, but she doesn’t view it that way! She encounters positivity even when it’s darkest! I think everyone should take something from her character and see things in a brighter light.

”Such a naughty mind.”
“Naughty insinuates the things I want to do to you are wrong. I can promise you they’ll feel very good.”

🏎️💨⋆𓈒 Santi!!!! This man!! It should be illegal this man being fictional. What do you mean he’s not real!? The way this man loves so much and so fearlessly!! It’s out of this world! It tugged on my heartstrings so so much! I was swooning every other page with what he said! And seeing him struggle but then finding in Chloe a reason to fight for himself and keep his head held high!! My heart 😭 I could literally spend days talking about him and that still wouldn’t make him justice.

And Santi’s relationship with Noah!!! Don’t even get me started! They’re the definition of brothers from another mother! It’s so amazing seeing how far these two have come since the first book! Their bond is so strong and pure! And what Noah did for Santi 🥹

Oh and of course the moments with little Marco had my ovaries imploding!

The only real complaint I have is that apart from Maya and Noah we didn’t really see the other characters from previous books. I wanted more moments, and given everything that happened I expected them more of their presence.

Oh and I need a spin-off series on their kids! Specifically Marko and Stella’s story!! It’s not a want it’s a need!!!!

But overall this is such a beautiful and hopeful love story that teaches us that even in the darkest of times and when you’re least expecting the right person can save you.

✐ᝰ quotes

The wildflowers remind me of her, beautiful in an untamed and understated kind of way.

”Do you like wildflowers?”
“There’s something beautiful about chaos.”

He cooks, he babysits, and he’s grumpy. My kind of kryptonite.

Screw him for crawling under my skin and making himself at home.

”I wanted someone to appreciate my presence rather than destroy it.”

”Because some people in life are worth the extra effort.”

She’s always been beautiful. But her by my side while I battle my demons? It’s a look that can’t compare.

”Life is about creating the memories that matter, while forgetting the ones that don’t.”

”You love me?”
“I’d be insane not to.”
